nodes.long_description:
1. Add potassium tartrate and sodium carbonate to a beaker with water.
2. turn on the heater until the solution becomes clear.
3. remove the impurities in the clear solution using filter paper and pour the filtered solution into a container and wait for it to crystallize.
4. Strike the crystallized piezoelectric element and see if it generates electricity.
5. Assemble the piezoelectric element onto a piezoelectric plate.
6. Try tapping the piezoelectric plate with a hammer or hitting it with a ball to turn on the lantern and charge the battery.
nodes.short_description: Discover how certain materials generate electricity when subjected to mechanical stress. This experiment explores the applications of the piezoelectric effect in generating renewable energy.
